# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering fixes and platform alignment**

## Highlights

Upcoming 4.156 work improves rendering reliability and moves Uno integration to Uno Platform 7. Android texture rendering follows display refresh, Linux HarfBuzz avoids symbol conflicts, and native callbacks use the correct boolean widths. Apple deployment minimums and Uno compatibility change; review the migration guidance before adopting these unreleased changes.

## Breaking Changes

- **Uno views require Uno Platform 7 and .NET 10** — The non-Windows Uno views now require Uno Platform 7 and net10.0. Migrate from the removed per-platform runtime packages and pre-Uno 7 WasmShell pipeline to Uno.Sdk's unified renderer and .NET SDK WebAssembly integration. Windows package facades continue to use SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Uno SKSwapChainPanel uses a CPU fallback** — On non-Windows Uno, SKSwapChainPanel now derives from Grid, renders through SKXamlCanvas, and reports a null GRContext. RaiseOnUnsupported is removed and DrawInBackground remains unsupported. Use SKCanvasElement for GPU rendering; the WinAppSDK control remains ANGLE-backed. ([#5377](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5377))
- **Apple deployment minimums increase** — Native SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now require macOS 11 or iOS/tvOS/Mac Catalyst 14. Managed iOS and tvOS minimums rise to 14; managed macOS 12 and Mac Catalyst 15 requirements remain higher. Raise deployment targets where necessary and retain any higher framework or application minimum. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **SKData.CreateCopy rejects lengths beyond the source array** — SKData.CreateCopy(byte[], ulong) now throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException when the requested length exceeds the array. Pass a length within the source array instead of relying on an out-of-bounds native read. ([#5429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5429))
- **Custom WebAssembly builds need rebuilt WebGPU archives** — For newer-than-.NET-8 WebGPU consumers, emdawnwebgpu C++ support now resides in libSkiaSharp.a rather than compiling on the application's final link line. Rebuild custom archives with the port support; pre-change or GPU-disabled archives do not satisfy this contract. The .NET 8 built-in WebGPU link path remains supported. ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Engine

- **Skia m156 shader and GLES corrections** — Rejects overflowing SkSL Raster Pipeline slot counts and invalid runtime-effect types during parsing. Ganesh GL no longer attempts BGRA8-as-RGBx uploads with a format invalid in GLES; readback is unchanged. ([#5489](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5489), [#5500](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5500))
- **Updated Windows ANGLE renderer** — Refreshes the WinUI ANGLE dependency from chromium/6275 to pinned chromium/8118 sources without changing the managed public API or Skia C API. ([#5321](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5321))

## Bug Fixes

- **Android continuous rendering follows display refresh** — Uses Choreographer pulses to pace automatic texture rendering, including MAUI SKGLView.HasRenderLoop, instead of drawing as fast as buffer swaps allow. Painting stays on the GL worker, and explicit render requests remain independent of display pacing. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Linux HarfBuzz stays within its bundled implementation** — Binds internal HarfBuzz function calls locally to prevent system HarfBuzz loaded by GTK from redirecting calls and mixing incompatible private objects. Exported entry points and managed signatures remain unchanged. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352))
- **Native callback boolean widths corrected** — Uses byte-width Skia C booleans and 32-bit HarfBuzz booleans at unmanaged callback boundaries, including stream and font callbacks. Public delegates still use bool; false glyph-name results return before copying the name buffer. ([#5479](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5479))
- **Character-code decoding and null validation corrected** — StringUtilities.GetUnicodeCharacterCode validates one encoded unit by byte width: ASCII in UTF-8, BMP characters in UTF-16, and full code points in UTF-32. Invalid inputs report the character parameter correctly, and GetString(byte[], ...) now throws ArgumentNullException for null arrays. ([#5506](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5506))
- **WebAssembly links no longer compile the WebGPU C++ port** — Bundles emdawnwebgpu C++ support in the native archive, avoiding the C++ standard flag being applied to application C sources. JavaScript compiler glue remains ordered link input rather than deployed application content. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Borrowed front-buffered streams are released on disposal** — Disposing SKFrontBufferedManagedStream clears its reference to the wrapped stream even when disposeUnderlyingStream is false. The borrowed stream is not disposed; its caller remains responsible for disposal. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))
- **Fewer temporary image and text allocations** — Valid managed pixel copies avoid an intermediate SKData allocation while preserving native validation for invalid inputs. HarfBuzzSharp pools AddUtf32 string encoding buffers and avoids native feature-string allocation without changing decoding behavior. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052), [#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060), [#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))

## Platform

- **Windows library dependencies aligned with MAUI 9 and 10** — Updates library inputs to Windows App SDK 1.7.250909003 and Windows SDK BuildTools 10.0.22621.756, with WebView2 1.0.3179.45 for native metadata resolution. This does not change the declared Windows runtime minimum. ([#5390](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5390))
